  PROBLEM: Cleanup may select the newest matching Implement run even when it has completed, leaving an active older run uncancelled.
  WHY: The helper filters out skipped runs but does not filter by active status, so cancellation can target a completed run and have no effect.

- tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py:380 | confidence=5

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4794-4809, 4853-4855 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `close_with_retry` function PATCHes the issues endpoint with `-f state_reason=not_planned` for all inputs, but `state_reason` is rejected by the GitHub API when closing a PR.
  WHY: Every attempt to close a PR using this path will return a 422 error, fail all 3 retry attempts, and leave the PR open, failing to resolve the cleanup gap.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:517-521 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: API read errors for `smoke_issue_state` are swallowed (`|| true` on `gh api`), and execution proceeds to evaluate the age rule.
  WHY: When the issue GET fails (e.g., transient network error), `smoke_issue_state` is empty. The code erroneously treats this as a signal to continue, potentially closing a PR based only on age when the issue might still be open (per the linked issue, API errors should skip the close action).

  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py:380 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds a 4th call to `find_latest_scoped_run_field "${TEST_REPO}"` at `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3744` (`LATE_IMPL_RUN_ID="$(find_latest_scoped_run_field "${TEST_REPO}" "${IMPL_CREATED_AFTER_INPUT:-}" "Implement" "${ISSUE_TITLE}" "id" 3 || true)"`), but the contract test still pins the count to 3.
  WHY: The assertion runs against the in-repo workflow text. The first three call sites at lines 947, 1116, 1498 still exist; the new call at 3744 raises the count to 4. The test fails on every CI run until the assertion is updated.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4846, 4850 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new Phase 3 cleanup loops use unquoted command substitutions and parameter expansions as word lists. ShellCheck flags these as SC2086, which fails the workflow lint gate.
  WHY: The lint check rejects the workflow file. The loops also mis-handle filenames or numbers that contain whitespace, but the immediate failure is the lint gate.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4835-4852, 4794-4809 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new PR-closing block calls `close_with_retry "${p}"` for each project PR, but the shared helper sends `state_reason=not_planned` to the issues endpoint.
  WHY: GitHub's "Update an issue" API rejects `state_reason` on the pull-request endpoint (422 Unprocessable Entity), so every retry returns the same rejection and the PRs stay open.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3744 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `find_latest_scoped_run_field` returns the newest non-skipped run matching the title regardless of `status`; the Phase 3b-waited Implement run may already have completed when cleanup attempts to cancel it.
  WHY: The cancel endpoint is a no-op on completed runs, so a late completed Implement run can still open a PR for the closed smoke issue.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:299, 313 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The two early-exit `AUTOFIX_SWEEP_END` lines do not emit the new `closed_smoke=` field.
  WHY: Workflow-log analysis expecting a fixed key set must special-case the early-exit lines or treat the missing field as a parser warning; the log-prefix contract is not enforced on every code path.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Cancel any queued, pending or in-progress Implement run for the smoke issue, using the run the gate already tracks in Phase 3b." (linked issue §Approach 1; PR description "Gap 1")
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, "Cleanup test artifacts" step (~lines 3735-3760), specifically the `find_latest_scoped_run_field` invocation at line 3744
  Evidence of absence: The cleanup cancels only the single run ID returned by `find_latest_scoped_run_field`. That helper does not filter by active status (`scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:240-250` selects only `conclusion != "skipped"`). The alt-model cleanup (line 5475-5476) does filter with `select(.status != "completed")` and lists runs directly, so the same status filter is available — the smoke cleanup's choice to reuse the unscoped helper means the cancel does not target active runs as the requirement specifies.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
